title: Control parameters
description: SSM String parameters written by DistrictWorkflow and read by both Lambdas, which cache them for at most 30 seconds so a change applies within 1 minute. A missing or unreadable parameter counts as false, so the survey fails closed.

/district-survey/{environment}/controls/.description: Accept tracked-link submissions, starts, claims and declines
Accept anything at all. Off closes both link types
